subject: Arch9 SRT pointer missing table-count bits; compute chain validator cannot express them
body:
New independently source-traced full-packet blocker: dispatch_v2 sets chain.resources=cmdVA+N2C_SRT (64-byte aligned, lowbits0). nord2_gpu_jm_build_compute in gpu/src/nord2_gpu_jm.c20 requires resources aligned64, and passes it unchanged to nord2_desc_shader_environment (gpu/src/nord2_gpu_desc.c44). But arch9 Resources encodes table count in low6bits: pinned Mesa pan_cmdstream.h261..308 returns T.gpu|nr_tables, with nr_tables aligned to MALI_RESOURCE_TABLE_SIZE_ALIGNMENT=4 (generatedv9_pack.h6379); panvk_cmd_desc_state.h48 extractslow6. Existing n2r graphics correctly uses (command+SRT)|4 at nord2_metal_render.c263/265. Our compute table entries0..2 need at least4allocated/zeroed records (64bytes), so resource pointer must carry count4, not0.

Do NOT merely OR4 into chain.resources: existing compute builder validator will reject it. Root must assign an additive count-aware compute-chain builder contract (gpu/include/nord2_gpu_jm.h + gpu/src/nord2_gpu_jm.c and mirroredshim if relevant) or another clearly validated additive wrapper to compute owner; preserve v1/noresources behavior and existing tests. Raw post-patching bytes without validating address/count is not an acceptable final fix. Integration test should decode both baseaddress and low6count from actual packet; positive table1/2 use count4, invalidcounts/alignment refuse, legacyresources0 remains unchanged. This escaped packer-only tests because resource entries themselves can be correct while the shader environment exposes zero tables. No production edit/build by audit.
